newsitem.title: UK: New Conservative pledge unjustified - UK's Blair.
newsitem.headline: New Conservative pledge unjustified - UK's Blair.

text.p: Opposition Labour party leader Tony Blair said on Tuesday that the ruling Conservatives' promise to hand out an extra 800 million pounds help to small businesses was unjustified.

Blair noted the Conservatives had made the pledge only a few days after promising an extra 1.5 billion pounds in tax relief under a scheme to allow couples to transfer personal income tax allowances where one spouse stopped work to look after children or elderly relatives.

"I don't know where they think they are going to get the money for this but I am not going to make the same mistake (on spending pledges)," Blair told a public meeting in the eastern town of Basildon.
He said some people were accusing Labour of being far too cautious in its election manifesto and not promising enough changes.
"What we are going to do is to deliver on what we have promised," he said.
